{{Quote|Huttbreaker. Revolutionary leader, liberator, and unofficial queen of Mek-Sha.|[[Hylo Visz]]|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Huttbreaker''' was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the unofficial [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]] in [[3627 BBY]]. Originally named '''Gritha Dar''', she was brought to the station as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] to serve the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] operation led by [[Prava]]. While her master was distracted by the [[Conquest of Makeb]], she persuaded [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], gun runners, former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and slavers to join her. With their support, Dar rallied her fellow slaves and [[Huttbreaker's Rebellion|defeated]] Prava and his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. With the space station taken, she named it Mek-Sha as a tribute to a friend, and formed a council of powerful figures to rule alongside her.<ref name="Codex" />
